components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single gold CTA of a view; never more than one per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 20px; border:none; border-radius:16px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fdddb4 0%,#d9b384 60%,#b99050 100%); color:#121214; font-family:Oswald,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:0.02em; box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(217,179,132,0.35); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s ease, filter .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9b384; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action on a hairline border; hover warms the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid #3a352b; border-radius:16px; background:#121214; color:#f8fafc; font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:16px; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color:#d9b384; color:#fdddb4; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9b384; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity:0.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Secondary highlighted action (e.g. export backup): accent fill at 15%.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid #d9b384; border-radius:16px; background:rgba(217,179,132,0.15); color:#fdddb4; font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:16px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background:rgba(217,179,132,0.25); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9b384; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-accent:disabled { opacity:0.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Instrument-like field: clean, 44px, accent focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Buscar ejercicio" aria-label="Buscar ejercicio" />
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #3a352b; border-radius:8px; background:#121214; color:#f8fafc; font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; caret-color:#d9b384; transition:border-color .15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:rgba(163,155,140,0.7); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#d9b384; outline:none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9b384; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:0.5; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Uppercase pill filter; selected fills with the accent and flips text to carbon.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid rgba(217,179,132,0.4); border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(217,179,132,0.12); color:#fdddb4; font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#d9b384; color:#121214; border-color:#d9b384; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9b384; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Resting surface: tonal gradient + top highlight + subtle gold border, ambient shadow only.
components.css: .ds-panel { position:relative; border-radius:16px; border:1px solid rgba(217,179,132,0.2); background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 0%, #242422 8%, #242422 100%); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 0 14px 32px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); padding:20px; } .ds-panel-label { margin:0 0 6px; font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#a39b8c; } .ds-panel-value { margin:0; font-family:Oswald,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:28px; line-height:1; letter-spacing:0.01em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#d9b384; }

components.name: Tab Bar Item (active)
components.description: Bottom navigation; the active tab carries the translucent accent pill, scaled icon and gold-gradient label.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display:flex; justify-content:space-around; border-top:1px solid #3a352b; background:rgba(18,18,20,0.95); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom); } .ds-tab { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px; min-height:56px; padding:0 6px; color:#a39b8c; text-decoration:none; font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:500; transition:color .2s ease; } .ds-tab svg { width:24px; height:24px; stroke-width:2; } .ds-tab-pill { position:absolute; top:6px; width:56px; height:28px; border-radius:9999px; background:transparent; } .ds-tab-active { color:#d9b384; } .ds-tab-active svg { stroke-width:2.5; transform:scale(1.05); } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-pill { background:rgba(217,179,132,0.15); } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-label { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fdddb4 0%,#d9b384 55%,#b99050 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9b384; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Back Link
components.description: Arrow + contextual label, min 44px target, gold-bright text.
components.html: Volver
components.css: .ds-backlink { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; color:#fdddb4; text-decoration:none; font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; } .ds-backlink svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-backlink:hover { color:#d9b384; } .ds-backlink:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9b384; outline-offset:2px; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Hero Atmosphere
components.description: The app's single photographic surface: a dark gym photo scrimmed into the Home hero with a soft-light gold tint. Decorative, non-interactive.
components.css: .ds-hero-atmosphere { position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; border-radius:inherit; pointer-events:none; background:#121214; } .ds-hero-atmosphere img { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:center 35%; opacity:0.5; } .ds-hero-atmosphere::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(18,18,20,0.88) 0%, rgba(18,18,20,0.62) 55%, rgba(18,18,20,0.18) 100%), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(18,18,20,0.82) 0%, transparent 55%); } .ds-hero-atmosphere::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background:rgba(217,179,132,0.24); mix-blend-mode:soft-light; }

narrative.overview:
A dark gym-as-laboratory: near-black iron surfaces, a single warm metal accent, and numbers that read like precision instrument readouts. Every screen is a workbench where effort becomes data — the interface recedes so the athlete's own figures (volume, sets, PRs, body composition) carry the visual weight.

The system is bold industrial-premium: confident, high-contrast, unapologetically dark by default, with the gold reserved for merit. Oswald's condensed, athletic geometry drives headlines and metric values; Barlow handles the reading body so nothing fights the numbers. Depth comes from tonal layering — a surface gradient with a top highlight and a whisper of gold border — never from hard shadows. The app is mobile-first and tactile: generous 44px+ targets, press feedback (scale, pop, row flash), and sound/haptics in the workout session.
keyCharacteristics: One accent metal (gold by default) used sparingly — the rarity is the point.
Dark industrial atmosphere with subtle film grain over the whole app.
A single photographic layer: a dark gym photo behind the Home hero, gold-tinted and scrimmed into the background; imagery is scarce, never decorative chrome.
Tonal elevation: gradient + top highlight + soft gold border; no decorative glows.
Oswald display numbers with tabular figures; Barlow body text.
Mobile-first single-column shell, bottom tab bar, one primary CTA per view.
Earned data is the hero: PRs, records and stats glow in the metal gradient.

rules.name: The Rare-Metal Rule
rules.body: The gold gradient is reserved for the single primary CTA of a view and for earned data (PRs, records, hero stats). Supporting actions use outline/accent/ghost, and resting surfaces stay monochrome, so the metal reads as reward, not chrome.

rules.name: The Subtle-Border Rule
rules.body: Panel borders are gold at 20–28% opacity. If the border is the first thing you see, it is too strong: hierarchy comes from tonal change and whitespace, not outlines.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every live or dynamic figure — stats, timers, weights — uses Oswald with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits don't jitter as they tick or change.

rules.name: The Kicker Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy arrives by weight and color before size. Section labels are uppercase kickers in bronze dust; you should be able to remove a heading's size and still read the hierarchy from weight and tone alone.

rules.name: The Elevation-by-Tone Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, elevation reads from tonal lift (gradient + highlight) first; box-shadows are ambient accents underneath, never the depth signal. If a card needs a hard shadow to float, its background is too close to the page background.

dos: Do reserve the gold gradient for exactly one CTA per view and for earned data (PRs, records, hero stats); everything else demotes to outline/accent/ghost.
Do build surfaces from panel / panel-floating / panel-hero tokens instead of bespoke card styles.
Do keep every touch target ≥ 44px and every gap ≥ 8px.
Do set dynamic numbers in Oswald with tabular-nums (.stat-value) and body copy in Barlow.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: page-in/reveal/burst animations are disabled; scroll behavior returns to auto.
Do use lucide-react icons for UI — never emoji as icons.
Do apply hero photography only through the hero-atmosphere treatment (dark scrim + gold tint + pointer-events: none + decorative aria-hidden), so text contrast never drops.
donts: Don't give resting cards hard drop shadows or decorative glows; depth comes from tone (Elevation-by-Tone Rule).
Don't strengthen panel borders past gold 28% (Subtle-Border Rule).
Don't duplicate the primary CTA in a view — one focus per screen.
Don't place light gold text on the gold gradient in day mode without checking contrast (the accent darkens in day to stay readable).
Don't hardcode colors outside the palette×theme system — always go through the CSS variables so the six palettes keep working.
Don't add photographs outside the hero without the Rare-Metal test — the dark-gold identity survives on scarcity, not on wallpapering panels with images.
